name: param-space-equilibria-and-nullclines
title: Equilibria, Nullclines & Oscillation (2-neuron)
question:
What is the phase-plane geometry of a two-neuron center-crossing CTRNN with
mixed-sign reciprocal coupling — where are its nullclines and equilibrium, and
is that equilibrium stable or does the circuit oscillate?
hypothesis:
The two nullclines intersect at a single interior equilibrium whose Jacobian
has eigenvalues with positive real part, so the circuit does not settle but
sustains a limit-cycle oscillation.
objective:
Compute the nullclines and equilibria of the 2-neuron net [[4.5,1],[-1,4.5]]
with center-crossing biases, classify the equilibrium by Jacobian eigenvalues,
and confirm sustained oscillation of the integrated trajectory.
claim:
The 2-neuron center-crossing circuit has a single unstable interior
equilibrium and oscillates — a minimal central pattern generator.
description:
Using the workspace's `analysis` layer (nullcline grid, multi-start equilibria,
Jacobian eigenvalues) and `viz.phase_portrait_2d`, we render the phase portrait
and read off the geometry. The sustained-oscillation behaviour is also pinned
by the CTRNN test suite (tail output range well above a settle threshold).

expected_behavior.name: two-neuron-oscillates
expected_behavior.rationale:
A center-crossing circuit with opposite-sign reciprocal coupling and strong
self-excitation destabilises its interior equilibrium; the tail range of a
neuron's output stays well above 0.05 (observed ≈ 0.62), i.e. it oscillates.

expected_behavior.name: single-interior-equilibrium
expected_behavior.rationale:
The nullclines intersect once in the relevant region; multi-start root
finding returns a single interior equilibrium, which the Jacobian classifies
as unstable (positive-real-part eigenvalues).

findings.summary: Single interior equilibrium, unstable; circuit oscillates (tail range ≈ 0.62).
findings.detail:
Phase portrait (figures/phase_portrait.png) shows the two nullclines crossing
at one interior point marked as unstable; the vector field circulates around
it, consistent with the sustained oscillation measured in the suite.

config.caption: 2-neuron center-crossing CTRNN: vector field, both nullclines, and the unstable interior equilibrium.
Video (dynamical analysis) — a state trajectory spiralling off the unstable equilibrium toward the limit cycle.

derived.insight: Single interior equilibrium, unstable; circuit oscillates (tail range ≈ 0.62).
